question: Who among the following became the Nawab of Bengal after Alivardi Khan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sirajuddaulah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sirajuddaulah** became the Nawab of Bengal after the death of **Alivardi Khan** in **1756**. He was the grandson of Alivardi Khan and succeeded him as the ruler of Bengal.
 
• Sirajuddaulah was a young and ambitious ruler, but his tenure was marked by conflicts with the **British East India Company**, primarily due to their increasing interference in the internal affairs of Bengal.
 
• The conflict culminated in the famous **Battle of Plassey** (1757), where Sirajuddaulah faced the British forces led by **Robert Clive**. Betrayal by his commander, **Mir Jafar**, led to his defeat.
 
• Sirajuddaulah’s reign was significant as it marked the beginning of British dominance in India, following their victory in the Battle of Plassey.
 
• After his defeat, Sirajuddaulah was captured and executed, and **Mir Jafar** was installed as a pup
